---
title: Storage Cost Comparison
---

These estimates compare US list prices and monthly storage charges in US dollars
as of 1 August 2026. AWS rates use US East (N. Virginia), and consumer plans use
US pricing. The estimates exclude API requests, retrieval, egress, temporary
restore copies, tax, and discounts. The 1 TB comparison uses 1,000 GB.

## 100 GB

| Service | Monthly cost | Price used | Supported by this CLI |
|---|---:|---|:---:|
| AWS S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval | **$0.40** | $0.004/GB-month | Yes |
| AWS S3 Standard | **$2.30** | $0.023/GB-month | Yes |
| Backblaze B2 | **$0.63** | $0.00695/GB-month after the first 10 GB free | Yes |
| Google Drive | **$1.99** | Google One Basic 100 GB plan | No |
| OneDrive | **$1.99** | Microsoft 365 Basic 100 GB plan | No |

## 1 TB

| Service | Monthly cost | Price used | Supported by this CLI |
|---|---:|---|:---:|
| AWS S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval | **$4.00** | 1,000 GB at $0.004/GB-month | Yes |
| AWS S3 Standard | **$23.00** | 1,000 GB at $0.023/GB-month | Yes |
| Backblaze B2 | **$6.88** | 990 billable GB after the first 10 GB free | Yes |
| Google Drive | **$9.99** | Cheapest plan covering 1 TB is the 2 TB plan | No |
| OneDrive | **$9.99** | Microsoft 365 Personal 1 TB plan | No |

## Important differences

AWS and Backblaze prices are metered object-storage charges. Google Drive and
OneDrive prices are fixed consumer subscription tiers that include other
services. This project currently supports S3-compatible storage only, so Google
Drive and OneDrive cannot be selected as `restic-stores`.

Glacier Instant Retrieval has a 90-day minimum storage duration, a 128 KB
minimum billable object size, and separate data-retrieval charges. S3 Standard
and B2 cost more to store but do not require an archive restore before normal
access. Backblaze includes free egress up to three times average monthly storage;
AWS transfer and request charges vary by usage and region.

Prices vary by country and can change. Check the current official pages before
choosing a provider:

- [Amazon S3 pricing](https://aws.amazon.com/s3/pricing/)
- [Backblaze B2 pricing](https://www.backblaze.com/cloud-storage/pricing)
- [Google One plans](https://one.google.com/about/plans?hl=en_US)
- [Microsoft OneDrive plans](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/onedrive/onedrive-plans-and-pricing?market=us)
